headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 7, 2026**
article:
The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged the Athletics 6-5, with Andrew Abbott earning the win, and the New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. The Seattle Mariners placed right-hander Cole Wilcox on the 15-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The Minnesota Twins placed right-hander Joe Ryan on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 5, 2026, with a left glute strain. The Cleveland Guardians placed right-hander Slade Cecconi on the 15-day injured list with right arm fatigue.

The Kansas City Royals bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. The Athletics acquired right-hander Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for right fielder Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded right-hander Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for right-hander Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded right-hander Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-hander Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Angels Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Mitch Farris earning the win. Zach Neto led the Angels' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Athletics in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-5 victory over the Athletics, with Andrew Abbott earning the win. Seth Johnson led the Athletics' pitching effort, striking out four batters in two innings of work.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Guardians in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Cleveland Guardians 13-6, securing a decisive win. Luis Torrens led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, going 2-for-4 with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Brewers Take Down Pirates 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 5-2 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, ending the game with a final score of 5-2. Gary Sánchez led the Pirates' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Aaron Ashby impressed in relief for the Brewers with 3 strikeouts in 1 inning.

top_news.title: **Mariners RHP Cole Wilcox Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Seattle Mariners right-hander Cole Wilcox has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left oblique strain.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the addition of first baseman Jacob Berry, acquired in a trade with the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as the team looks to strengthen its offense.
